rubric_intent: Score a small Python utility on basic engineering qualities.

dimensions.name: Tested behavior
dimensions.description: Behavior is covered by automated tests.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Look for test files asserting behavior.

dimensions.name: Documented surface
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Look for docstrings or README sections describing usage.

dimensions.name: Error handling
dimensions.description: Failure modes are handled, not raised generically.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Look for try/except blocks and named exceptions.

dimensions.name: Stated invariants
dimensions.description: Invariants/contracts stated in code or docs.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Look for comments, asserts, or doc claims about invariants.
